title: The Heavy End
event: 12 Nov 2026: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO; Nvidia closed about 4% lower while rival chip stocks rose, and the S&P 500 still fell. Why: the index is weighted by size, the ten biggest companies carry about 40% of it, and Nvidia was the heaviest. By 19 Nov the S&P 500 had fallen six days in a row, about 8% below its October record
angle: the mechanism: how one giant can pull the whole S&P 500 down even when its rivals rise (index weighting and concentration)
sources: 12 Nov 2026: Reuters (Mikolajczak, Nishant) via Illawarra Mercury/Devdiscourse/NST: Huang resigns, Nvidia closes -4.3%, Broadcom and AMD among the biggest boosts, S&P 500 -0.35% to 7,592.40; AP via La Nacion: other AI chip stocks rose
